\*\*\*\*\*Memorial Hills\*\*\*\*\*



\*"Underwritten Net Operating Income"\* shall mean, as of any date of calculation, the sum of: (a) (i) the monthly gross Rents from Leases in effect as of such date from Tenants that are current on their rental obligations, annualized, adjusted for a vacancy factor equal to the greater of (x) actual vacancy, or (y) 5.0%, and (ii) the Operating Income (excluding Rents from Leases) for the trailing twelve-month actual total, minus (b) the sum of: (i) concessions based on a trailing six-month actual total, annualized, and (ii) Operating Expenses for the 12-month period ending on such date, assuming (x) base property management fees equal to the greater of (1) the actual amount paid by Borrower during such prior 12-month period, and (2) 2.50% of Gross Revenues, and (y) a normalized adjustment for Replacements equal to $200 per unit at the Property per annum.



\*"Operating Income"\* shall mean, for any period, all income of Borrower during such period from the use, ownership or operation of the Property, including all amounts collected by Borrower that are payable by any Person as Rent and other amounts under Leases or other agreements relating to the Property. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Operating Income shall not include (a) any Rent attributable to a Lease prior to the date in which the Tenant thereunder has taken occupancy, (b) security deposits received from Tenants until forfeited or applied, or (c) any Lease termination payments other than penalties payable by tenants under the Leases.



\*"Operating Expenses"\* shall mean, for any period, without duplication, all expenses actually paid or payable by Borrower during such period in connection with the operation, management, maintenance, repair and use of the Property, computed in accordance with GAAP, including (i) all expenses incurred in the immediately preceding twelve (12)-month period, (ii) property management fees in an amount equal to the greater of (A) the management fees actually paid under the Management Agreement, and (B) 2.50% of Gross Revenues, (iii) administrative, payroll, security and general expenses for the Property, and (iv) Taxes and Other Charges (other than income taxes) and insurance premiums. Operating Expenses shall not include (1) depreciation or amortization, (2) income taxes, (3) Capital Expenditures, and (4) Debt Service.
